<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_UniversityEnrollment" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/university-enrollment">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Application" name="Application submitted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MissingDocs" name="Missing documents notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DocsProvided" name="Missing documents provided"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Accept" name="Acceptance letter"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Reject" name="Rejection letter"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_EnrollConfirm" name="Enrollment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Orientation" name="Orientation materials"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Cancel" name="Application canceled notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_GradesPosted" name="Grades posted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_AppealSubmitted" name="Appeal form submitted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_AppealDecision" name="Appeal decision"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Graduate" name="Graduation notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Withdraw" name="Withdrawal notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Continue" name="Continuing enrollment notice"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_Enrollment" name="University Enrollment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Student" name="Prospective Student" processRef="Process_Student"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_University" name="University" processRef="Process_University"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Application" name="Application submitted" sourceRef="S_Submit" targetRef="U_StartApp" messageRef="Msg_Application"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_MissingDocs" name="Missing documents notice" sourceRef="U_SendMissing" targetRef="S_CatchMissing" messageRef="Msg_MissingDocs"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DocsProvided" name="Missing documents provided" sourceRef="S_ProvideDocs" targetRef="U_CatchProvided" messageRef="Msg_DocsProvided"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Accept" name="Acceptance letter" sourceRef="U_SendAccept" targetRef="S_CatchAccept" messageRef="Msg_Accept"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Reject" name="Rejection letter" sourceRef="U_SendReject" targetRef="S_CatchReject" messageRef="Msg_Reject"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_EnrollConfirm" name="Enrollment confirmation" sourceRef="S_Confirm" targetRef="U_CatchConfirm" messageRef="Msg_EnrollConfirm"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Orientation" name="Orientation materials" sourceRef="U_SendOrient" targetRef="S_CatchOrient" messageRef="Msg_Orientation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Cancel" name="Application canceled notice" sourceRef="U_SendCancel" targetRef="Participant_Student" messageRef="Msg_Cancel"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_GradesPosted" name="Grades posted" sourceRef="U_SendGrades" targetRef="S_CatchGrades" messageRef="Msg_GradesPosted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AppealSubmitted" name="Appeal form submitted" sourceRef="S_SubmitAppeal" targetRef="U_CatchAppealSub" messageRef="Msg_AppealSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AppealDecision" name="Appeal decision" sourceRef="U_SendAppealDec" targetRef="S_CatchAppealDec" messageRef="Msg_AppealDecision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Graduate" name="Graduation notice" sourceRef="S_SendGrad" targetRef="U_CatchGrad" messageRef="Msg_Graduate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Withdraw" name="Withdrawal notice" sourceRef="S_SendWd" targetRef="U_CatchWd" messageRef="Msg_Withdraw"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Continue" name="Continuing enrollment notice" sourceRef="S_SendCont" targetRef="U_CatchCont" messageRef="Msg_Continue"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Student" name="Prospective Student Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="S_Start" name="Application process starts"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="S_Submit" name="Submit online application"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="S_StatusMerge" name="Application status update"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="S_Outcome" name="Await admission outcome"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="S_CatchMissing" name="Missing documents notice received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="S_CatchMissing_Def" messageRef="Msg_MissingDocs"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="S_ProvideDocs" name="Provide missing documents"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="S_CatchReject" name="Rejection letter received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="S_CatchReject_Def" messageRef="Msg_Reject"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="S_EndRejected" name="Application rejected"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="S_CatchAccept" name="Acceptance letter received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="S_CatchAccept_Def" messageRef="Msg_Accept"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="S_Confirm" name="Confirm enrollment by deadline"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="S_CatchOrient" name="Orientation materials received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="S_CatchOrient_Def" messageRef="Msg_Orientation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="S_Card" name="Obtain student ID card"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="S_StudyPlan" name="Create study plan">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="SP_Start" name="Study plan started"/>
      <bpmn:userTask id="SP_Advisor" name="Meet with academic advisor"/>
      <bpmn:userTask id="SP_Courses" name="Select courses"/>
      <bpmn:userTask id="SP_Conflicts" name="Resolve schedule conflicts"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="SP_End" name="Study plan created"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_F1" sourceRef="SP_Start" targetRef="SP_Advisor"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_F2" sourceRef="SP_Advisor" targetRef="SP_Courses"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_F3" sourceRef="SP_Courses" targetRef="SP_Conflicts"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_F4" sourceRef="SP_Conflicts" targetRef="SP_End"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="S_NextSem" name="Semester start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="S_Attend" name="Attend classes"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="S_AddDropSplit" name="Add or drop courses?" default="S_F18"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="S_AddDrop" name="Add or drop courses within add/drop period"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="S_AddDropMerge" name="Add/drop handled"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="S_CatchGrades" name="Grades posted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="S_CatchGrades_Def" messageRef="Msg_GradesPosted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="S_Review" name="Review grades online"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="S_GrievSplit" name="Grievance to file?" default="S_F24"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="S_Appeal" name="File appeal">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="AP_Start" name="Appeal started"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="S_SubmitAppeal" name="Submit appeal form"/>
      <bpmn:userTask id="S_MeetCommittee" name="Meet with appeals committee"/>
      <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="S_CatchAppealDec" name="Appeal decision received">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="S_CatchAppealDec_Def" messageRef="Msg_AppealDecision"/>
      </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="AP_End" name="Appeal decided"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="AP_F1" sourceRef="AP_Start" targetRef="S_SubmitAppeal"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="AP_F2" sourceRef="S_SubmitAppeal" targetRef="S_MeetCommittee"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="AP_F3" sourceRef="S_MeetCommittee" targetRef="S_CatchAppealDec"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="AP_F4" sourceRef="S_CatchAppealDec" targetRef="AP_End"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="S_GrievMerge" name="Grievance handled"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="S_FinalSplit" name="Student status?" default="S_F29"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="S_SendGrad" name="Send graduation notice"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="S_EndGrad" name="Graduated"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="S_SendWd" name="Send withdrawal notice"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="S_EndWd" name="Withdrawn"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="S_SendCont" name="Send continuing enrollment notice"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F1" sourceRef="S_Start" targetRef="S_Submit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F2" sourceRef="S_Submit" targetRef="S_StatusMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F3" sourceRef="S_StatusMerge" targetRef="S_Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F4" sourceRef="S_Outcome" targetRef="S_CatchMissing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F5" sourceRef="S_Outcome" targetRef="S_CatchReject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F6" sourceRef="S_Outcome" targetRef="S_CatchAccept"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F7" sourceRef="S_CatchMissing" targetRef="S_ProvideDocs"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F8" sourceRef="S_ProvideDocs" targetRef="S_StatusMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F9" sourceRef="S_CatchReject" targetRef="S_EndRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F10" sourceRef="S_CatchAccept" targetRef="S_Confirm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F11" sourceRef="S_Confirm" targetRef="S_CatchOrient"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F12" sourceRef="S_CatchOrient" targetRef="S_Card"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F13" sourceRef="S_Card" targetRef="S_StudyPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F14" sourceRef="S_StudyPlan" targetRef="S_NextSem"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F15" sourceRef="S_NextSem" targetRef="S_Attend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F16" sourceRef="S_Attend" targetRef="S_AddDropSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F17" name="Yes" sourceRef="S_AddDropSplit" targetRef="S_AddDrop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>${addDropRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F18" name="No" sourceRef="S_AddDropSplit" targetRef="S_AddDropMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F19" sourceRef="S_AddDrop" targetRef="S_AddDropMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F20" sourceRef="S_AddDropMerge" targetRef="S_CatchGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F21" sourceRef="S_CatchGrades" targetRef="S_Review"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F22" sourceRef="S_Review" targetRef="S_GrievSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F23" name="Yes" sourceRef="S_GrievSplit" targetRef="S_Appeal">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>${grievanceFiled}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F24" name="No" sourceRef="S_GrievSplit" targetRef="S_GrievMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F25" sourceRef="S_Appeal" targetRef="S_GrievMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F26" sourceRef="S_GrievMerge" targetRef="S_FinalSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F27" name="Graduates" sourceRef="S_FinalSplit" targetRef="S_SendGrad">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>${graduates}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F28" name="Withdraws" sourceRef="S_FinalSplit" targetRef="S_SendWd">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>${withdraws}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F29" name="Continues" sourceRef="S_FinalSplit" targetRef="S_SendCont"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F30" sourceRef="S_SendGrad" targetRef="S_EndGrad"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F31" sourceRef="S_SendWd" targetRef="S_EndWd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F32" sourceRef="S_SendCont" targetRef="S_NextSem"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_University" name="University Enrollment Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="U_StartApp" name="Application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="U_StartApp_Def" messageRef="Msg_Application"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="U_Review" name="Review application and supporting documents"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="U_DocsSplit" name="All documents received?" default="U_F3"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="U_SendMissing" name="Notify applicant of missing documents"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="U_CatchProvided" name="Missing documents provided">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="U_CatchProvided_Def" messageRef="Msg_DocsProvided"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="U_DocsMerge" name="Documents complete"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="U_Fork" name="Start evaluation and fee processing"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="U_Evaluate" name="Evaluate application (admissions committee)"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="U_Fees" name="Process application fees or waivers (finance)"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="U_Join" name="Evaluation and fee processing complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="U_Decision" name="Application accepted?" default="U_F14"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="U_SendAccept" name="Send acceptance letter"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="U_SendReject" name="Send rejection letter"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="U_EndRejected" name="Application rejected"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="U_EvGw" name="Await enrollment confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="U_CatchConfirm" name="Enrollment confirmation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="U_CatchConfirm_Def" messageRef="Msg_EnrollConfirm"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="U_CatchDeadline" name="Enrollment deadline passed">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="U_CatchDeadline_Def"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="U_Cancel" name="Cancel application"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="U_SendCancel" name="Send cancellation notice"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="U_EndCanceled" name="Application canceled"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="U_OnbFork" name="Start onboarding"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="U_SendOrient" name="Send orientation materials"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="U_IT" name="Set up student accounts (email, online portals, library access)"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="U_IntlSplit" name="International student?" default="U_F27"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="U_Visa" name="Assist with visa processing (international student office)"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="U_IntlMerge" name="Visa step complete"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="U_OnbJoin" name="Onboarding complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="U_SemMerge" name="Semester start"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="U_PostGrades" name="Post end-of-semester grades"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="U_SendGrades" name="Send grades posted notice"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="U_StatusMerge" name="Student status update"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="U_StatusEvt" name="Await student status"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="U_CatchCont" name="Continuing enrollment notice received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="U_CatchCont_Def" messageRef="Msg_Continue"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="U_CatchGrad" name="Graduation notice received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="U_CatchGrad_Def" messageRef="Msg_Graduate"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="U_CatchWd" name="Withdrawal notice received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="U_CatchWd_Def" messageRef="Msg_Withdraw"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="U_CatchAppealSub" name="Appeal form received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="U_CatchAppealSub_Def" messageRef="Msg_AppealSubmitted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="U_EndGrad" name="Student graduated"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="U_EndWd" name="Student withdrawn"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="U_ReviewAppeal" name="Review appeal with appeals committee"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="U_SendAppealDec" name="Send appeal decision"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F1" sourceRef="U_StartApp" targetRef="U_Review"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F2" sourceRef="U_Review" targetRef="U_DocsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F3" name="Complete" sourceRef="U_DocsSplit" targetRef="U_DocsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F4" name="Missing" sourceRef="U_DocsSplit" targetRef="U_SendMissing">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>${documentsMissing}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F5" sourceRef="U_SendMissing" targetRef="U_CatchProvided"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F6" sourceRef="U_CatchProvided" targetRef="U_DocsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F7" sourceRef="U_DocsMerge" targetRef="U_Fork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F8" sourceRef="U_Fork" targetRef="U_Evaluate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F9" sourceRef="U_Fork" targetRef="U_Fees"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F10" sourceRef="U_Evaluate" targetRef="U_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F11" sourceRef="U_Fees" targetRef="U_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F12" sourceRef="U_Join" targetRef="U_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F13" name="Accepted" sourceRef="U_Decision" targetRef="U_SendAccept">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>${accepted}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F14" name="Rejected" sourceRef="U_Decision" targetRef="U_SendReject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F15" sourceRef="U_SendReject" targetRef="U_EndRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F16" sourceRef="U_SendAccept" targetRef="U_EvGw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F17" sourceRef="U_EvGw" targetRef="U_CatchConfirm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F18" sourceRef="U_EvGw" targetRef="U_CatchDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F19" sourceRef="U_CatchDeadline" targetRef="U_Cancel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F20" sourceRef="U_Cancel" targetRef="U_SendCancel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F21" sourceRef="U_SendCancel" targetRef="U_EndCanceled"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F22" sourceRef="U_CatchConfirm" targetRef="U_OnbFork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F23" sourceRef="U_OnbFork" targetRef="U_SendOrient"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F24" sourceRef="U_OnbFork" targetRef="U_IT"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F25" sourceRef="U_OnbFork" targetRef="U_IntlSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F26" name="Yes" sourceRef="U_IntlSplit" targetRef="U_Visa">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>${internationalStudent}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F27" name="No" sourceRef="U_IntlSplit" targetRef="U_IntlMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F28" sourceRef="U_Visa" targetRef="U_IntlMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F29" sourceRef="U_IntlMerge" targetRef="U_OnbJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F30" sourceRef="U_SendOrient" targetRef="U_OnbJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F31" sourceRef="U_IT" targetRef="U_OnbJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F32" sourceRef="U_OnbJoin" targetRef="U_SemMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F33" sourceRef="U_SemMerge" targetRef="U_PostGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F34" sourceRef="U_PostGrades" targetRef="U_SendGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F35" sourceRef="U_SendGrades" targetRef="U_StatusMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F36" sourceRef="U_StatusMerge" targetRef="U_StatusEvt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F37" sourceRef="U_StatusEvt" targetRef="U_CatchCont"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F38" sourceRef="U_StatusEvt" targetRef="U_CatchGrad"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F39" sourceRef="U_StatusEvt" targetRef="U_CatchWd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F40" sourceRef="U_StatusEvt" targetRef="U_CatchAppealSub"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F41" sourceRef="U_CatchCont" targetRef="U_SemMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F42" sourceRef="U_CatchGrad" targetRef="U_EndGrad"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F43" sourceRef="U_CatchWd" targetRef="U_EndWd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F44" sourceRef="U_CatchAppealSub" targetRef="U_ReviewAppeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F45" sourceRef="U_ReviewAppeal" targetRef="U_SendAppealDec"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_F46" sourceRef="U_SendAppealDec" targetRef="U_StatusMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_UniversityEnrollment" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/university-enrollment">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Application" name="Application submitted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MissingDocs" name="Missing documents notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DocsProvided" name="Missing documents provided"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Accept" name="Acceptance letter"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Reject" name="Rejection letter"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_EnrollConfirm" name="Enrollment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Orientation" name="Orientation materials"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_GradesPosted" name="Grades posted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_AppealSubmitted" name="Appeal form submitted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_AppealDecision" name="Appeal decision"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Continue" name="Continuing enrollment notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Graduate" name="Graduation notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Withdraw" name="Withdrawal notice"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_Enrollment" name="University Enrollment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Student" name="Prospective Student" processRef="Process_Student"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_University" name="University" processRef="Process_University"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Application" name="Application submitted" sourceRef="S_Submit" targetRef="U_Start" messageRef="Msg_Application"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_MissingDocs" name="Missing documents notice" sourceRef="U_SendMissing" targetRef="S_CatchMissing" messageRef="Msg_MissingDocs"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DocsProvided" name="Missing documents provided" sourceRef="S_ProvideDocs" targetRef="U_CatchProvided" messageRef="Msg_DocsProvided"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Reject" name="Rejection letter" sourceRef="U_SendReject" targetRef="S_CatchReject" messageRef="Msg_Reject"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Accept" name="Acceptance letter" sourceRef="U_SendAccept" targetRef="S_CatchAccept" messageRef="Msg_Accept"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_EnrollConfirm" name="Enrollment confirmation" sourceRef="S_Confirm" targetRef="U_CatchConfirm" messageRef="Msg_EnrollConfirm"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Orientation" name="Orientation materials" sourceRef="U_SendOrient" targetRef="S_CatchOrient" messageRef="Msg_Orientation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_GradesPosted" name="Grades posted" sourceRef="U_SendGrades" targetRef="S_CatchGrades" messageRef="Msg_GradesPosted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AppealSubmitted" name="Appeal form submitted" sourceRef="AP_Submit" targetRef="U_CatchAppeal" messageRef="Msg_AppealSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AppealDecision" name="Appeal decision" sourceRef="U_SendAppealDec" targetRef="AP_CatchDec" messageRef="Msg_AppealDecision"/>
